function.name: read_docs
function.description: Retrieve a section of the frozen risk manual (doc: policy | workflow).

function.name: get_case_details
function.description: Look up the case under review — a pending card transaction (TXN-...), a limit-increase request (LIM-...) or an outbound transfer (TRF-...). A case may list several ranked alternatives under `legs`; leg 1 is the customer's first preference.

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Look up an account: holder, home state, verification level, standing, tenure, current credit limit, and today's approved same-day total (today_total).

function.name: get_merchant_details
function.description: Look up a merchant: name, category, region.

function.name: get_payee_details
function.description: Look up a transfer payee: name, type, jurisdiction, and how many days ago the payee was added (added_days_ago).

function.name: deny_case
function.description: Deny the pending case, citing a reason code. Final.

function.name: escalate_case
function.description: Send the pending case to manual review, citing a reason code. Final.

function.name: execute_leg
function.description: Carry out one of a case's ranked alternatives, identified by its leg number. Final.

function.name: decide_batch
function.description: Settle every line of a payment batch in one call. `decisions` is a list of {line, action, reason} objects — action is approve, deny or escalate, and reason is required unless the action is approve. Every line must appear exactly once. Final.

function.name: finish
function.description: End the episode after your decision tool call. Takes no arguments. Call it exactly once, as the only call of its turn.
